data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nur' meaning 'light'. Nardeen symbolizes radiance and illumination. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the light of Allah guides and protects the believers. The name Nardeen carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nardeen usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nardeen total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
